name: Aptivra-Base-110M
context_scaling: Inherited unchanged from intfloat/e5-base-v2 (config.json max_position_embeddings 512). This derivative does not publish a context-extension recipe of its own.
attention_variant: bidirectional encoder (BERT), full attention, no causal mask
notes: ADDED 2026-11-01. Fine-tune of intfloat/e5-base-v2 (12 layers, 768 hidden, 0.109B) into a skill-routing embedding model. Same tensor set as the base; the config was not changed. MIT. Recorded on rerank-OFF numbers only, which is the honest arm: the card measures the embedding alone against e5-base-v2 with a paired bootstrap on the current corpus - human routing Recall@1 0.820 -> 0.958 (+0.138, 95% CI [0.102, 0.175]), weak-pair 0.654 -> 0.701 (+0.047, CI [0.040, 0.054]), adversarial 0.784 -> 0.817 (+0.033, CI [-0.006, 0.071] = NOT significant by the card's own CI). The much better rerank-ON numbers (0.985 / 0.973 / 0.994) belong to a lexical reranker that is NOT in this download, and the card says so twice; they are excluded here. The eval corpus is the author's own routing fixtures, so this is a domain adaptation result, not a general BEIR claim.
